summary: Phase E (Phase 20) comprehensive testing completed - all 39 Playwright tests passed, backend API fully functional, no regressions detected. Tested: Sovereign Bloodline scenario with breeding mechanics, keeper assignment markers, creature idle life (blink/breathing/footprints), ambient audio system with Web Audio synthesis, and all existing features.
passed_tests: Backend API: All CRUD operations (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE) working correctly with new additive stats keys (birthsBySpecies, inbredBySpecies, maturedBySpecies, courtships)
Scenario Menu: 6 scenario cards displayed, Sovereign Bloodline shows BRUTAL difficulty with +◈50,000 reward
Scenario Setup: sovereign_bloodline starts with 2 contained Nyxarr, 1 xenobiologist assigned, ~45k budget, tier 3-4 damaged fences, breeding research granted
Scenario Tracker: Live progress chips update correctly (offspring 0/3, healthy 2/2, deadline Cycle 1/16), reacts to welfare changes
Scenario Victory: All 4 goals evaluate correctly, +50k reward paid, mastery grading works (swift earned, dynasty not)
Scenario Fails: Deadline (Cycle 16) and inbreeding fail conditions trigger correctly with defeat dialog
Breeding System: Nyxarr pair-tolerant (max 2), adults-only capacity check, courtship and birth mechanics working, offspring chip updates
Keeper Markers: Pins render over assigned enclosures, disappear when unassigned, fan out when multiple keepers share pen (18px+ spacing)
Idle Life - Blink: Auto-derived blink frames from eye highlights (1-12 pixel diff), resting creatures keep eyes shut, walkers neutral
Idle Life - Motion: Breathing pulse and periodic tail-flick shear over 400-frame window
Idle Life - Footprints: Walking creatures leave decals, fade out over ~210 frames (TTL working)
Audio Manager: Installed pre-gesture (ctx null), unlocks on first click, logs UI clicks
Audio Controls: Popover opens, mute toggle persists to localStorage (aetherion_audio_enabled), volume slider updates manager and persists (aetherion_audio_volume)
Audio Beds: Storm raises wind + adds rain, night hum only with glowing exhibits, live targets follow running game
Audio One-shots: Rejected placement plays deny cue, victory alert fires success stinger
Regressions: Sandbox game boots, save/load round trip works, tool selection functional, modals open/close, photo mode working, no page errors
